column2: @@EN@@ Lunch rush. No internet. No problem.
@@EN@@ Khaynjo runs your floor, kitchen and counter on devices you already own — from table to kitchen to bill, with or without the internet.
@@EN@@ Android on Google Play today · Windows and Linux packages coming.
@@EN@@ Your books stay on your devices
@@EN@@ Tap a table to walk it through a visit. Same colours and words as the app — and a table frees only once it is paid.

@@EN@@ One famous dish from every country — the English name, the name in their own script, and the dish in English. Put those words on your menu. The world keeps moving past; pause or search when you want to look.
@@EN@@ Find a country or dish — e.g. India, biryani, Japan
@@EN@@ One famous dish per country — the parade loops the whole world.
@@EN@@ Watch a table go from Seated to Paid — the same steps and colours your staff see in the app.
@@EN@@ Seat the table, take the order
@@EN@@ Mark the table Occupied the moment guests sit. Add dishes, pick a size, add extras, and type a note for the kitchen — right at the table.
@@EN@@ Pick one size; add optional extras up to the limit you set.
@@EN@@ “Less spicy” travels with the dish it belongs to.
@@EN@@ Send the order and each station gets only its own dishes — numbered per day, with the table, the waiter and every note. Never a price: the kitchen cooks, the counter bills.
@@EN@@ Send, and the ticket prints at the right station — nobody carries it.
@@EN@@ The kitchen sees what to cook now
@@EN@@ On the kitchen screen tickets move New → Preparing → Ready with one tap. Older tickets warm in colour, “To cook now” counts every dish waiting, and mains can hold until the starters go.
@@EN@@ Settle any way the guest pays
@@EN@@ Cash with change to return, UPI with the amount already in the QR, part payment, or Due on the customer's khata. Split by item, by seat or evenly. The table frees only when its bill is paid.
@@EN@@ A tip is recorded on its own — never mixed into sales.
@@EN@@ Close the day you can trust

@@EN@@ Count the drawer against the float, cash taken, tips and cash paid out — short or over is named. Print the shift slip, then open the day report by staff, order type, hour and dish, with cancels, comps and tips.
@@EN@@ The changes that happen every lunch — handled in the open, with who, when and why kept.
@@EN@@ Guests change tables — the order and its minutes go with them. Two tables, one bill.
@@EN@@ With a reason, cooked or not, and who approved it. The kitchen gets a cancel slip.
@@EN@@ A comp stays on the bill at ₹ 0, with the reason and the approver.
@@EN@@ Each action is allowed, allowed with a manager PIN, or not allowed — person by person.
@@EN@@ Search by name or short code, with aliases in another language — “ptk” finds Paneer tikka.
@@EN@@ A dearer price in the AC room; breakfast menus and happy-hour prices by the clock.
@@EN@@ Part payments and Due go on the customer's account in Parties, settled later.
@@EN@@ Sales by staff, order type, hour and dish — with cancels, comps and tips listed.
@@EN@@ Set up your counter and pick a starter menu with photos — then change names, prices and codes to your own. Free to download from khaynjo.com.
@@EN@@ World cuisines — Japanese, Mexican, Italian, Indian, Thai and more — each dish with its photo.
@@EN@@ Tea, coffee, cold drinks, bakery and snacks — ready for a counter café.
@@EN@@ The full public photo shelf — pick the picture for any dish you add.
@@EN@@ The internet went down. The counter didn't.

@@EN@@ Orders, kitchen tickets, bills and the day book live on your own devices. When the internet drops in the middle of lunch, nothing in your restaurant waits for it — and there is no account with us to sign in to.
@@EN@@ Counter: taking orders and settling bills
@@EN@@ Day book: every bill saved on this device
@@EN@@ Captains' tablets and the kitchen screen: working together on your own Wi-Fi
@@EN@@ Software capability is not what we sell. Run the whole of Khaynjo on your own devices at no cost — nothing is locked behind a plan.
@@EN@@ Floor, kitchen, billing, day close, reports — the full app.
@@EN@@ No charge per table, waiter, order or device.
@@EN@@ Day-to-day service needs no sign-up and no internet.
@@EN@@ Yearly cloud if you want it
@@EN@@ Steady ₹6,000 · Swift ₹12,000 · Priority ₹24,000 / year ex-tax (tax at checkout). Custom is a quote — may be below Steady or above Priority. Local Khaynjo stays free forever either way.
@@EN@@ Shop plans at /shop · sign in at /account
@@EN@@ No. Orders, KOTs, bills and the day book work with no internet. You need it once to download the app and, if you want one, a starter menu.
@@EN@@ On your own device, in your shop — not on our servers. Make backup copies from Settings and keep them wherever you like.
@@EN@@ Which devices does it run on?
@@EN@@ Android phones and tablets today, from Google Play. Windows and Linux packages are on their way.
@@EN@@ Does it print KOTs and bills?
@@EN@@ Yes — on thermal printers you set up in Settings → Printers, one kitchen ticket per station.
@@EN@@ Can my staff use their own language?
@@EN@@ Yes. The screens come in 115 languages, Arabic and Urdu right-to-left, and dish names can carry aliases in another script.
@@EN@@ Nothing on your own devices — every feature, forever. Optional Kumkaj Cloud is yearly Steady / Swift / Priority (or a Custom quote); open /shop to buy.
@@EN@@ Run your next service on Khaynjo.
@@EN@@ Free on Google Play. Want a walk-through first? Message us on WhatsApp.
@@EN@@ Installers go up here once each one passes a clean-machine install. Until then, ask for a demo on WhatsApp.
@@EN@@ The WhatsApp demo line opens soon. Your message will read: “{message}”.
